Instructions.title: How to Export Audio from Your Video Editor

finalCutPro.step1: Select your video project in Final Cut Pro
finalCutPro.step2: Go to File > Share > Master File
finalCutPro.step3: In the settings, choose 'Audio Only' format
finalCutPro.step4: Export as WAV, AIFF, or MP3 format
finalCutPro.step5: Upload the exported audio file below

premierePro.step1: Select your video project in Premiere Pro
premierePro.step2: Go to File > Export > Media (Cmd/Ctrl + M)
premierePro.step3: In export settings, set Format to 'Audio Only'
premierePro.step4: Choose WAV, AIFF, or MP3 format and export
premierePro.step5: Upload the exported audio file below

davinciResolve.step1: Select your video project in DaVinci Resolve
davinciResolve.step2: Go to Deliver page and select your timeline
davinciResolve.step3: Set Format to 'Audio' and choose audio codec
davinciResolve.step4: Export as WAV, AIFF, or MP3 format
davinciResolve.step5: Upload the exported audio file below
